title: La pulpería
goal: Buy the small things at the shop on the corner
culture: A pulpería is a front room with a grille, and it sells one of everything: soap, eggs, a single cigarette, rice by the pound. You do not go in — you stand at the window and say me da.

beats.objective: Ask for a bar of soap
beats.en: Give me a bar of soap.
ok: me da un jabon por favor
beats.good: Me da is how you ask for things across a counter — softer than quiero and shorter than everything else. It is the single most useful phrase in this district.

beats.en: For washing myself. And a fizzy drink.
beats.good: Two kinds of soap and he will always ask which. Gaseosa is any fizzy drink; if you want a Coca-Cola you say Coca and he will not be surprised.
Nada más closes the order. Del tiempo means room temperature and is what you get if you do not say fría.
